statement: The distributed harness's cluster-ACTIVE certification probe reports the state at the deadline, never a stale sample: within an attempt, nodes sampled unreachable at attempt start are re-sampled once with the same per-node admin/readiness probe after the seed snapshot lane completes, provided the re-sample is issued at or before the deadline (joinActiveProbeAttemptAtDeadline in cluster-class-active-probe-attempt-join.js; a re-sample past the deadline is refused as not_admitted_after_deadline), the snapshot lane never delays the attempt's return past the deadline (a lane still running at the deadline is the typed deadline_bounded outcome with snapshot_lane_running_at_deadline), and the timed-out gate reason is the typed progress classification progress_observed or stalled_no_progress according to whether the active count rose on the final attempt; ACTIVE stays each node's own admin/readiness answer, the 60-second window, poll interval, force-repair threshold and extension rules are unchanged and no attempt starts after the deadline. Run 2026-08-30T14-05-20 (all five admin APIs up by W+52.4; attempt 6 sampled node-2 unreachable 2.8 s before its listener opened, then blocked 10.8 s on the snapshot lane and returned past the deadline as stalled_no_progress) is reproduced verbatim on HEAD by a virtual-clock witness and certified after the cure when the lane ends inside the window.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
A re-sample is issued at most once per attempt and only at an instant at or before the deadline; no node sample issued after the deadline ever enters the verdict.
ACTIVE remains each node's own admin/readiness answer; snapshot counts, publishedActive and coverage never derive a node's ACTIVE.
The 60-second window, poll interval, force-repair threshold and both one-shot extension rules are unchanged; no attempt starts after the deadline; no sleeps; no src/ change.

The snapshot lane never delays an attempt's return past the deadline; a lane still running at the deadline is a typed deadline_bounded outcome, not a silent wait; stalled_no_progress is emitted only when the active count did not rise on the final attempt, otherwise progress_observed.

Proof is a virtual-clock witness on the real active-wait loop and probe reproducing run 2026-08-30T14-05-20 verbatim on HEAD (attempts=6, elapsed 60600, 4/5), red on HEAD (4/8) and green after (8/8), with the never-opens, all-active and budgets controls that must stay green; no GCP run is part of the proof.
